name: openrouter-image-mcp
description: Generate and save images through OpenRouter from MCP clients.

scripts.clean:build: node --input-type=module --eval "import fs from 'node:fs'; fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.clean:test: node --input-type=module --eval "import fs from 'node:fs'; fs.rmSync('.test-dist', { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run clean:test && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test .test-dist/tests/**/*.test.js
